integrity.scope: one theorem on joint component-count/largest-component complement law

scientific_limitations: The model is a uniform cyclic chord matching conditioned on all crossing-graph degrees being even, not a random realizable Gauss diagram.
The stated total-variation error is order n^{-1}; the constants are not optimized.
Connected parity-reversing chord diagrams and exact connected-count enumeration were described previously by Blitvic (2014).
Historical priority of joint limit assessed against selected sources but is not independently certified.
title: A joint Poisson(2) component law for parity-conditioned random circle graphs
